_about: Source of truth for colour, spacing and radius. Each category's `glint` is the light tint its day bar ticks catch along their top edge (work from the design, the rest 60% of the way to white, like work). Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/tokens.py`. `placeholder: true` marks a system default no design has set yet. `darkDerived: true` means the light value comes from a design and the dark value was derived by us, not designed.

background.use: Screen and sheet background; icon wells

textSecondary.use: Captions, labels, units, times. Light is 3.5:1 on white: below AA for small text, see QUESTIONS.md

separator.use: Dashed dividers and hairlines: ink at 10%

outline.use: Border of a framed group inside a card (the day bar box): ink at 5%

cardStroke.use: Card edge; only drawn in dark, where shadows don't show

gap.use: Skeletons; the dashed outline of a gap row

unmapped.use: Unmapped ticks on the day bar: outline and stripes, #DADADA at 80%

accent.use: Tint, primary actions, insight charts; also the app's AccentColor

live.use: The live dot next to the timer

yours.use: Tint of the Yours hero stat

inverseGlow.use: The warm light along the confirmation card's top edge

tabBar.use: Tint over the tab bar's frosted glass: white 20%

tabBarStroke.use: The tab bar's border: ink at 10%

tabInactive.use: Labels of the tabs not selected

step.use: Getting started: the step numbers and their Now / Next / Then tags

scrim.use: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet, over a blur

glowShade.use: The grey a sheet's glow fades out to at its edges (Turn on your location)

glowRays.use: The light rays behind a sheet's art (Turn on your location)

glass.use: Controls over the sunrise (the day pill)

glassPill.use: You: the pills' glass ("41 places", "3.2% mapped", "Your dial"): white 65% (Figma)

glassShadow.use: You: the pills' drop shadow, #1B1C1D at 5% (Figma), showing through the glass

glassControl.use: The back button's glass before iOS 26: white 80% under the drawn glass (Figma)

wrapCentre.use: The weekly wrap invite: the light blue at the middle of its radial fill

wrapEdge.use: The weekly wrap invite: the deep blue at the edge of its radial fill

toggleOff.use: The design's switch, off. Read from the screenshot

privacy.use: The privacy line's bar ("Only you can see your map"). Read from the screenshot

gold.use: A gold badge's medal (stand-in until the badge art arrives)

rhythmLunch.use: Time: Your rhythm, lunch. Read from the screenshot

yearEdge.use: Time: the year in places card, the edge of its radial fill. Read from the screenshot

everythingElse.use: The chart fold bucket, Everything else. Not a category. Time design

sky._about: Today's header skies, drawn in code by SkyView, sampled from the four sky images. `sky` runs top to bottom over the whole header; `horizon` runs from the horizon line to the bottom edge (empty when the sky has none). `body` and `bodyEdge` light the sun (the moon at night) top to bottom; `glow` is its halo. The sky follows the time of day, not light or dark mode.
